title: Fire-Watch ingest event
description: The event contract accepted by the HTTP ingress. Producers POST one of these, an array of them, or {"events": [...]} to /events.

EVT_AgentOwner.title: Support team owning the tool sending the event
EVT_AgentOwner.description: Not ownership of the actual monitor — the agent that shipped the event.

EVT_Identifier.title: Optional event ID/identifier
EVT_Identifier.description: When blank, the ingress generates one. Two events with the same content are deduplicated on content, not on this field, so re-using it does not create a second alert.

EVT_Device.title: Device/server/host that event is about
EVT_Device.description: Becomes the alert's source, so device + EVT_EventKey identifies the alert.

EVT_EventKey.title: EventKey needed to ensure automations, ownership, handling etc.
EVT_EventKey.description: Becomes the alert's type. Device + EventKey is the alert identity.

EVT_Severity.title: Events' default/original severity
EVT_Severity.description: Mapped onto the internal severity scale by the ingress. CLEAR and HARMLESS retire an alert.

EVT_Agent.title: What tool/technology is sending the event

EVT_Summary.title: Event summary
EVT_Summary.description: The single line shown in the alert table.

EVT_Details.title: Details message
EVT_Details.description: The expandable body. Compressed at the worker when large enough.

EVT_URL.title: Optional link/deep link to a page with full event details
